ngc-6397.d: One of the oldest known globular clusters in the Milky Way with a core-collapsed structure.

crab-nebula.d: Pulsar wind plerion remnant created by the historical supernova of 1054 recorded by Chinese astronomers.

helix-nebula.d: The closest planetary nebula to Earth, showing a dying low-mass star shedding its outer gas shell.

chamaeleon-cloud-complex.d: High-latitude southern molecular cloud complex rich in T Tauri protostars and reflection nebulae.
